caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a meat cleaver, centered on a plain off-white background. The cleaver has a broad, rectangular, slightly curved blade that is shaded in various tones of gray, suggesting a metallic material with visible textures and some irregular dark patches. The handle is elongated, straight, and colored in shades of brown with darker streaks, indicating a wood grain texture. The handle is attached to the blade with two visible rivets near the top. There are some subtle, uneven light yellowish stains or marks on the background, but no other objects or elements are present in the composition. The artist’s signature, "N. Amansta," is written in small letters near the lower left side of the image.
title: Chopping Knife
